name: Gary
greeting: You want the good stuff or the MENU stuff?

topics.label: Ask for the recipe
topics.line: So what's actually in the sandwich?
topics.goodText: "Love. And none of your business." He's delighted you asked.

topics.label: Ask about town gossip
topics.goodText: "Todd didn't come in for his usual order today. Third time this month. Kid's got the weirdest schedule I've ever seen."
topics.badText: "Me? I don't gossip." He gossips constantly.

topics.label: Ask for a part-time shift
topics.line: Could you use an extra pair of hands?
topics.goodText: "You show up, you work, you eat. That's the deal." Deli shifts unlocked.

topics.label: Mention you saw something weird last night
topics.line: Something happened last night. Something... wrong.
topics.goodText: He gets very quiet. "I didn't see anything. I see everything. But I didn't see THIS." He's seen it too.

topics.label: Ask about the freezer
topics.goodText: "It's been doing that. Colder every night. Like it's thinking."

gifts.likeText: "Where'd you find this?" He tucks it behind the counter like treasure.

hangouts: Gary teaches you to wrap a sandwich so tight it could survive a fall. "Life skill."
